summary: Standard Notes is a self-hosted note-taking application designed to keep your written records private. It provides a centralised server backend alongside client applications to store and sync your plain text or formatted notes securely.
goodFor: It is a good fit for individuals or small teams who prioritise data privacy and want control over their sync server.
watchOut: Setup and ongoing maintenance can involve managing multiple components like a database and background workers, which introduces operational overhead.
deployNotes: As a Ruby application, it typically requires a persistent database, a reverse proxy for TLS termination, and process management for background queues.
